# Feature Request

Thank you for suggesting a feature for KibaOS! We appreciate your ideas and feedback. Please fill out the template below to help us understand your proposal.

## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. For example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Describe the Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. How would this feature improve KibaOS?

## Describe Alternatives
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? If so, please describe them.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here. This helps us understand your vision better.

---

## Feature Evaluation

To help us assess your feature request, please consider:

- [ ] Does this align with KibaOS's philosophy of "modern simplicity"?
- [ ] Would this feature benefit most KibaOS users, or is it a niche use case?
- [ ] Can this be implemented without significantly increasing system complexity or resource usage?
- [ ] Is this feature already available through existing KibaOS tools or configurations?

## Implementation Notes (Optional)

If you have technical knowledge and want to help with implementation:

- **Component affected:** [e.g., installer, desktop environment, package management]
- **Potential approach:** Brief technical description of how this could be implemented
- **Dependencies:** Any new packages or libraries that would be required
- **Testing considerations:** How this feature should be tested

---

> [!NOTE]
> Before submitting, please check:
> 1. This feature hasn't already been requested (search existing issues)
> 2. This isn't already possible through existing configuration
> 3. You've discussed this in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/WolfTech-Innovations/Kiba/discussions) if it's a significant change

> [!TIP]
> For major features, we recommend opening a discussion first to gather community feedback before submitting a formal feature request.
